en: Black‑and‑white aerial view of a historic European town center. The focus is a large Romanesque-Gothic cathedral complex with a tall bell tower, rounded apse, octagonal central tower, and adjacent crenellated palace-like building. Beside it lies a broad cobbled square bordered by arcaded buildings; at the center of the square stands a large baroque fountain with multiple tiers and sculptures. The image has a white scalloped border typical of vintage postcards.
